input_contract.decision_source: closed canonical derived 4h bars available at decision time
input_contract.mark_source: exact retained 1m MARK; LAST substitution forbidden
input_contract.funding_source: original retained millisecond events and Decimal rates
input_contract.warmup: 42 completed 4h closes ending at Monday 00:00 UTC
input_contract.funding_policy: retained source-venue proxy; unusable or missing authority is UNKNOWN/INTEGRITY_BLOCKED

chronology_and_continuity.eligible_no_trade_week: included zero-return observation with continuous carry
chronology_and_continuity.metadata_ineligible_week: calendar-only carry, excluded from return statistics and bootstrap blocks
chronology_and_continuity.terminated_symbol: eligible weeks remain explicit cash-only zero-return observations
chronology_and_continuity.integrity_unknown: stop task; do not advance an authoritative economic ledger

bounded_access.parquet_read_unit: one monthly component shard or one row group

reporting_gates.economics: full symbol/scenario/partition equity, costs, funding, fills, forced exits, exposure and drawdown
reporting_gates.uncertainty: unresolved inventory or authority is never ordinary censoring or zero
reporting_gates.evaluation: exact v0.2.0 validation, retrospective and bootstrap gates

limitations: Binance history is a source-venue proxy evaluated with fixed WEEX cost assumptions.
One-minute OHLC cannot establish tick order, queue position, partial fills or liquidation mechanics.
Accepted MARK gaps and price discrepancies remain explicit calendar exclusions.
The retained funding schedule classification remains partial or uncertain.
No future executable or run identity is approved by this plan.
